label: Auditing (Server security facility)
type: one of the four named Server security facilities: the recording of administrative and data actions to a per-node audit log. Do NOT confuse with monitoring:activity-log or monitoring:event, which are Capella management-plane concepts with a severity enum and alerting behaviour that Server's audit_event has neither of.
note: Promoted as a facility alongside security:authentication. The non-merge with Capella's monitoring:* family is this round's most carefully argued open question: Server's audit.log is explicitly per-node ('individual per node records must be manually consolidated by the administrator') and categorises events as Admin/Data/User-Activity, sharing no vocabulary with monitoring:event-severity-enum. The possibility that Capella's Activity Log is a management-plane view over this same mechanism is plausible and unstated on any page read so far, so it is flagged for SME review rather than merged.
